title: Audit semantics and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility
objective: Convert the static semantic scan into a prioritized manual and automated accessibility baseline.
acceptance_checks: manual checks not replaced by automation
known heading, nav, and image gaps tracked

result.summary: WCAG 2.2 AA baseline completed read-only across all 23 pages with structural scans and representative Firefox renders.
p1_findings: Inline links rely on insufficient color-only differentiation
16 descendant pages misuse aria-current=page for a parent route
Research CTA and certificate targets are invalid
Reveal may transiently hide focused links
Sticky header focus obstruction needs manual confirmation
p2_findings: Three research page-nav blocks lack nav landmarks
Nine images lack intrinsic metadata and lazy loading
